summary: The PRDocuments module is responsible for managing placement request documents within the HSPnet system. It includes functionalities related to document uploading, editing, deleting, and handling document data.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing documents associated with placement requests, including actions like uploading, editing, and deleting documents.

workflows.name: Document Upload
steps: Metadata about the file is stored

workflows.name: Document Edit
steps: Changes are made to document metadata
Document is saved with new details

business_rules: File upload must contain non-empty content
Only specific document types can be uploaded
validations: Ensure file content is not empty
Validate document type against predefined types
conditions: If document exists, edit mode can be enabled
If user session is null, operations are canceled
system_behavior: Document details are shown in a modal window
